content: VERIFIED from official docs (docs.bullmq.io/guide/workers and /guide/workers/graceful-shutdown, fetched 2026-09-08): stalled jobs occur when the worker cannot renew its lock (typically a blocked event loop); a stalled job is moved back to waiting and processed AGAIN, possibly while the original worker still runs it, causing duplicate side effects; after the max stall count the job moves to failed. stalledInterval controls renewal cadence (defaults not on page); maxStalledCount caps stalls. worker.close() stops fetching and waits for current jobs; it does not time out by itself; ungraceful shutdown yields stalled-job recovery on other workers.
